description: Completed an intensive web development internship in collaboration with Techfest (Annual Science & Technology Festival of IIT Bombay). Engineered responsive frontend interfaces, implemented dynamic web applications, and collaborated on advanced project implementations.

Selected for an advanced internship program in Emerging Technologies. Leveraged IBM Cloud, IBM SkillsBuild, and IBM BoB to architect autonomous agentic AI workflows, examine quantum computing paradigms, and apply modern cybersecurity practices.

Engaged in hands-on data analytics workflows across diverse business datasets. Performed data hygiene, feature engineering, exploratory data analysis (EDA), and generated visual insight reports in a collaborative team setting.
